newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EU, U.S, officials see WTO chief over Cuba row.
newsitem.headline: EU, U.S, officials see WTO chief over Cuba row.

text.p: European Union and United States officials met World Trade Organisation chief Renato Ruggiero to discuss their row over the U.S. Helms-Burton law on trade with Cuba, trade sources said.
Ruggiero was later on Thursday due to name a three-man WTO panel to look into the dispute.

Brussels says the law, aimed against foreign investment in the communist-ruled island's economy, violates WTO open trading rules and is an attempt to extend the reach of U.S. courts to other countries.

Washington says Helms-Burton aims at restoring "freedom and democracy" in Cuba and is a move dictated by U.S. national security. It argues that this means it is outside the jurisdiction of the WTO. -- Geneva newsroom - 41 22 751 0991
